instruction: Can you fix the margins in the current build. Confirmed scope: both the clipping/overflow seen on Your World and a spacing pass on the shared workspace content column, affecting every workspace page.
objective: Every workspace page presents the same content column: one shared max-width, one shared gutter, centred the same way. Country pages currently use their own 1500px/20px left-aligned column and must be brought onto the shared values. Also unblock the build, which is failing on a missing WorldPin re-export.
requiredChanges: country page content column adopts the shared workspace max-width, gutter and centring
re-export WorldPin from world-match-map so the build compiles
